info.about: X-Men Origins: Wolverine is a 2009 action-adventure game based on the film of the same name. The game release coincided with the release of the film on May 1, 2009, for the PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Windows, Wii, PlayStation 2, Nintendo DS and PlayStation Portable.
info.trivia: Only the PS3, Xbox 360 and PC versions are the M-rated Uncaged Edition; the Wii, PS2 and PSP versions were toned down to a Teen rating.
info.why: It was delisted from all digital storefronts on January 1, 2014 when Activision's Marvel licence expired, and was Activision's last Wolverine game.
